recognize_zh: 左側一顆細胞質深藍、邊緣充滿淡藍小圓泡（Russell bodies）的漿細胞，核呈多葉不規則狀，旁邊可見正常顆粒的骨髓細胞與後骨髓細胞可比較；泡狀包涵體塞滿細胞質是 Mott cell 的特徵，而多葉核提示不典型漿細胞。
features: Plasma cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous pale blue round globules (Russell bodies)
Irregular, lobulated/multilobed dark nucleus in the inclusion-bearing cell
Adjacent normal myelocyte and band/metamyelocyte with pink granular cytoplasm for comparison
Nearby small lymphocyte and scattered platelets
Sparse cellularity at this smear edge
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a plasma cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm filled with numerous pale blue round globules consistent with Russell bodies, and an irregular, lobulated nucleus. Adjacent cells include a normally granulated myelocyte, a band or metamyelocyte, and a small lymphocyte. The lobulated nucleus is an atypical feature that raises concern for a neoplastic plasma cell, although Mott cells alone are not specific. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell bearing Russell body inclusions (Mott cell); clonality studies and plasma cell quantification are recommended.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes have granular lilac cytoplasm with blebs and are CD61 positive, rather than basophilic cytoplasm packed with pale globules.
Monocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with clear vacuoles and folded lacy-chromatin nuclei, lacking immunoglobulin globules.
These show large immature cells with prominent nucleoli and high N:C ratio in sheets, whereas this is an isolated globule-laden plasma cell.
